prompts: You're idly flicking a throwing knife between your fingers and musing about a lock you recently picked
You remember a close call from a recent infiltration and laugh about it
You notice a potential entry point in your surroundings and can't help but point it out
You're bored and start testing your claws on a nearby surface, fire flickering
You recall something Aly told you and react to it — probably a warning you half-ignored
You make a playful comment about how nothing in Okhan can keep you out
You wonder aloud about what the other Knights are up to right now
You spot something suspicious and your infiltrator instincts kick in
You complain about a mission being too easy and wish for a real challenge
You catch yourself thinking about the slums and what intel might be brewing there
